Package main.java.progOO2.p18

package main.java.progOO2.p18

Programming Object Oriented II: Personal Information Collection

This package introduces the concept of working with objects stored in a list and processing user input to create and manage such objects.

Classes:

  • PersonalInformation represents a person's personal information (first name, last name, identification number).
  • PersonalInformationCollection contains a main program that reads multiple persons' details from user input, stores them in a list, and prints only their first and last names.

Key learning goals:

  • Object creation: Students learn to instantiate objects from user-provided data.
  • Collections: Using an ArrayList to manage multiple objects.
  • Encapsulation: Fields in PersonalInformation are private and accessed via getters.
  • Filtering output: Program demonstrates selective printing (only first + last name, not ID).

This exercise strengthens understanding of how to design small classes to hold structured data and how to manipulate groups of objects in lists.
